summary: 26-year-old man with a possible broken ankle after a 15-ft fall near the first tower, Mt. Blanca/Little Bear Peak; AVSAR deployed with Flight For Life; winds blocked the night evac so two rescuers and the patient sheltered at ~12,500 ft; a National Guard chopper flew them to Ft. Garland on Oct 6 and the patient went to SLV Health Center.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR / Flight For Life / National Guard
